title: Glogau
place: Glogau (Głogów) on the Oder, Lower Silesia: the fortress and the cathedral island
about: fortress town on the south bank of the Oder; marshy river meadows; flat ground to the south

towns.name: Glogau
towns.src: inferred: walled town, about 0.9 km across

notes: Relief: Terrarium (surface model) with woods and buildings filled from the fields around them.
Woods, water and marsh: ESA WorldCover 2021, today's cover. Woods under 1.5 ha are dropped as orchards and hedgerows.
Villages: today's built-up cells (WorldCover) joined to a gazetteer point; their 1740 extent may differ.
Glogau: walled town, about 0.9 km across (inferred extent).
Dom (cathedral island): cathedral precinct across the river (inferred extent).
Brooks: traced from the relief (catchment over 6 km2), not from a map; their courses are approximate.
Roads: today's country roads (Overture Maps), left out inside today's towns; most follow the old ways between the same villages, but none is mapped from 1740.
sources: Relief: AWS Terrain Tiles (Terrarium; Mapzen, EU-DEM, SRTM)
